canonicalFacts.claim: Breast cancer incidence rates were stable among all racial/ethnic groups from 2004 to 2008, with approximately 230,480 new cases expected in 2011
Breast cancer death rates have been declining since the early 1990s for all women except American Indians/Alaska Natives
Aromatase inhibitors are more effective than tamoxifen in postmenopausal women but are ineffective in premenopausal women when used without ovarian suppression
Radiation therapy following breast-conserving surgery decreases mortality and recurrence in early-stage breast cancer
Sentinel lymph node removal is now standard of care for patients with early stage breast cancer without sentinel lymph node metastases
